newsitem.title: GREECE: ATEMKE TO INAUGURATE SEIRIOS APR 18.
newsitem.headline: ATEMKE TO INAUGURATE SEIRIOS APR 18.

text.p: Construction company Atemke will inaugurate its "Seirios" car service station on the Athens - Lamia national autoroute in April 18, it said on Tuesday.
Seirios, built by Atemke, cost 6.0 billion drachmas.
Italian businessman Gilberto Benetton will be present in the inauguration as Atemke has a deal with Benetton Group subsidiary Autogrill to operate the service station up to the year 2023.
To celebrate the event guests will also be able to check out a Benetton formula 1 race car, it said.

Atemke's deal with Autogrill calls for the joint construction and operation of additional service stations on Greek highways. Atemke has started construction of its second service station in the 66th kilometre of the Athens - Lamia autoroute, it said.
Seirios will feature Autogrill restaurants, snack-bars and a mini market, a Goody's fast-food restaurant, and EKO fuel service stations and car wash.
Interamerican and Express Service will provide road assistance and Commercial Bank will provide banking services via Telebank.

"Based on Autogrill's feasibility study and current traffic loads Seirios is forecast to service around 5,000 customers daily. Atemke will have revenues of 10 billion drachmas based on signed contracts with other operators in the station," it said.
Atemke shares closed down 55 drachmas at 1,500 on Tuesday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
